# DEC-0003: Use PostgreSQL on AWS RDS

Status: Accepted · 2026-09-12 · decided by Aliyu
Tags: tech:aws-rds tech:postgres

## Context
Bookings need transactions and the team already runs PostgreSQL.

Backups must be daily.

## Decision
Use PostgreSQL on AWS RDS.

## Consequences
Rules out a document database. Ties us to AWS.
